faqs.question: What services does Unique Web Layer offer?
faqs.answer: We offer Web Development, App Development, Digital Marketing, and Video Production services. We build custom websites, mobile apps, run marketing campaigns, and create professional videos for businesses of all sizes.

faqs.question: How much does a website cost?
faqs.answer: Our website pricing starts from $499 for a basic 5-page website, $999 for a business website with CMS, $1999 for e-commerce websites, and custom web apps from $5000. Contact us for a personalized quote based on your requirements.

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.answer: Yes! We work with clients worldwide including US, Canada, UK, Australia, and many other countries. Our remote workflow is optimized for global collaboration.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a website?
faqs.answer: Timeline depends on complexity: Basic websites take 2-3 weeks, business websites 3-4 weeks, e-commerce 4-6 weeks, and custom web apps 6-10 weeks.

faqs.question: Do you provide support after project completion?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide free support for 1-3 months depending on the package. Extended support and maintenance packages are also available starting from $99/month.

faqs.question: What technologies do you use?
faqs.answer: We use modern technologies including React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Laravel, MongoDB, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, and more based on project requirements.

faqs.question: Can you redesign my existing website?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We specialize in website redesigns that improve user experience, loading speed, and conversion rates. Contact us with your current website URL for a free consultation.

faqs.question: How can I start a project with Unique Web Layer?
faqs.answer: Click the 'Start Project' button on our website, fill out the contact form, or reach out via email or phone. We'll schedule a free consultation to understand your requirements and provide a detailed quote.

faqs.question: Do you offer SEO services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer comprehensive SEO packages starting from $299/month including keyword research, on-page SEO, backlink building, and monthly performance reports.

faqs.question: What is your payment structure?
faqs.answer: We typically require 50% advance to start the project and 50% upon completion. For larger projects, we offer milestone-based payments.
